cat > bench2.py <<'EOF'
import sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/scratch')
import gen_big
import analyze as A
import z3
rng = random.Random(1)
req = gen_big.build(rng, tight=False)
inst = A._parse_request(req)
orig = A.opt_bound
calls = []
def timed(opt, expr, minimize):
    t0=time.time()
    v = orig(opt, expr, minimize)
    dt = time.time()-t0
    calls.append(dt)
    return v
A.opt_bound = timed
t0=time.time()
res = A.analyze(inst, req['id'])
print('total %.2f status %s k=%s' % (time.time()-t0, res['status'], res.get('min_faults')))
import statistics
print('calls', len(calls), 'sum %.2f' % sum(calls), 'max %.2f' % max(calls))
# print the slowest 15
idx = sorted(range(len(calls)), key=lambda i: -calls[i])[:15]
print('slowest', [(i, round(calls[i],2)) for i in idx])
EOF
(timeout 240 python3 -u bench2.py > bench2.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> bench2.log) & sleep 100; cat bench2.log
